article.headline: Dominick Nelson scores 15 to lead Utah Valley over California Baptist 75-69
article.description: — Dominick Nelson scored 15 points as Utah Valley beat Cal Baptist 75-69 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Dominick Nelson scores 15 to lead Utah Valley over California Baptist 75-69

categories.description: California Baptist Lancers @ Utah Valley Wolverines

event.description: California Baptist Lancers @ Utah Valley Wolverines

keywords: California Baptist Lancers @ Utah Valley Wolverines
article.story: OREM, Utah -- — Dominick Nelson scored 15 points as Utah Valley beat Cal Baptist 75-69 on Saturday. Nelson had seven rebounds and three steals for the Wolverines (11-6, 3-0 Western Athletic Conference). Tanner Toolson scored 14 and grabbed six rebounds. Carter Welling had nine points as Utah Valley upped its win streak to six. The Lancers (8-8, 1-1) were led by AJ Braun with 16 points. Dominique Daniels Jr. added 15 points and five assists. Adam Moussa finished with 13 points, seven assists and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
